description: This file defines the OnyxGuardrail class which extends CustomGuardrail to implement guardrail validation for LLM calls using Onyx security platform. It involves methods for validating requests/responses by calling an external Onyx guard server, handling API credentials, and configuring guardrail behavior.

classes.name: OnyxGuardrail
classes.description: A guardrail class for integrating Onyx security checks into LLM request/response flows, validating via external guard server and handling associated logic.

methods.description: Main method to apply the guardrail check on given inputs, preparing payload based on request or response, calling validation, and handling errors.
